purpose: Teach: 会報/受け継が/持論/定評/堅調/申し分/セグメント/第一人者

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 会報、若い頃、私も編集していたな。
lines.en: I edited the newsletter myself when I was young.
lines.style: Nostalgic, matter-of-fact. Light on the memory. Quiet voice, steady pace. A glance backward without dwelling. The weight of experience offered without ceremony.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。受け継がれてきた文化、大切にします。
lines.en: Yes. I'll treasure what's been passed down to us.
lines.style: Respectful, attentive lean. Careful precision on each phrase. Warm but formal — the tone of someone receiving something precious and meaning it completely. Steady eye contact held.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 持論は、明確に持っておけ。
lines.en: Have a clear philosophy of your own.
lines.style: Firm and measured. Not harsh — a grandfather's instruction spoken with quiet conviction. Slight weight on 「明確に」. The voice of someone who has watched people succeed and fail by this rule.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。市場での定評、引き続き保ちたい。
lines.en: Yes. I want to keep the trust we've built in the market.
lines.style: Earnest and grounded. No flourish — just a clear statement of intent. Thoughtful pace, as if turning the responsibility over in his hands. Modest but certain.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 業績の堅調、油断するな。
lines.en: Don't let success make you careless.
lines.style: Sharp warning, but not unkind. Slight uptick on 「油断」 — the danger in the word itself. A pause before and after, framing the caution. The voice of someone who has seen complacency cost everything.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。申し分ない数字でも、慢心しません。
lines.en: Yes. Even with good numbers, I won't grow arrogant.
lines.style: Steady agreement. Slight clarifying tone — as if he's thought about this before. Each clause weighted equally. No defensiveness, just the simple commitment of someone who understands the warning.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 顧客セグメントを細分化し、対応せよ。
lines.en: Segment your customers carefully. Respond to each group.
lines.style: Practical instruction delivered with certainty. The voice of a strategist sharing what works. Crisp, clear pacing. A touch slower on 「細分化」 — the precision matters. Direct but not demanding.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界の第一人者、おもてなしに、心を尽くします。
lines.en: As industry leaders, we'll dedicate ourselves to genuine care for each customer.
lines.style: Quiet resolve. The closing note of someone who has heard wisdom and is already turning it into action. Warm but not sentimental. Slight softening on 「心を尽くします」 — sincerity without drama. The promise of someone who means it.
